title: Analyzing the Impact of Fake News on the Anticipated Outcome of the 2024 Election Ahead of Time
measurement_description: The paper measures the presence of fake news in news articles categorized under the 'Religious Dimension' as part of a broader dataset construction and analysis focused on political discourse, racial slurs, and biases in North America.
findings: The analysis of the created dataset revealed that news articles categorized under the 'Religious Dimension' constituted 18.8% of the corpus, making it the third largest thematic category. This indicates that religion is a significant component of the political news discourse analyzed, although no specific qualitative findings about religious fake news were detailed.
